tools.name: cast_bazi_chart
tools.description: Cast a BaZi (Four Pillars, 八字) chart from a birth date, local clock time and IANA time zone. Returns each pillar's stem, branch, elements, ten god, hidden stems, na yin, twelve life stages, void branches and symbolic stars; the 胎元, 命宮 and 身宮; the 節 instants either side of the birth; and ten luck pil

tools.name: get_bazi_strength
tools.description: Judge the Day Master's strength and the favourable and unfavourable elements (喜用神) for a birth by Kaucim's published support-and-restrain scoring (fuyi-v1). Returns strong, weak or balanced, the support ratio, every scored slot with its weight, the ranked favourable elements and a seasonal (調候) hint

tools.name: cast_ziwei_chart
tools.description: Lay out a Zi Wei Dou Shu (紫微斗數) chart: the twelve palaces with their major and minor stars and brightness, the birth-year transformations (四化), the Life and Body Palaces, the five-element class and each palace's ten-year range. Same birth input as cast_bazi_chart.

tools.name: get_almanac
tools.description: Read the Chinese almanac (通勝, 黃曆) for 1 to 31 consecutive days: lunar date, year, month and day pillars, any solar term with its local time, the activities listed as suitable (宜) and to avoid (忌) with English glosses, the day's clash, the twelve officers, the day god and the auspicious double hours.

tools.name: find_auspicious_days
tools.description: Find days in a date range that the almanac marks suitable for a wedding, moving home or opening a business, graded good, fair or caution. Give up to four people's births to grade each day against their day pillars and zodiac branches; a clash with anyone marks the day caution. Defaults to the next t

tools.name: draw_fortune_stick
tools.description: Draw a temple fortune stick (求籤) at random, or read one the person already holds, from Wong Tai Sin (黃大仙), Che Kung (車公), Guan Yin (觀音), Sixty Jiazi (六十甲子) or Guan Di (關帝). Returns the verse, its grade, the published explanation, the free reading for the question type and the stick's page. Draw once

tools.name: get_reference_sources
tools.description: Read the current public reference index: canonical source links, available languages, citation scope, limits and dataset versions. It does not fetch each linked page.

tools.name: get_product_catalog
tools.description: Read current public products, supported languages, routes, pricing sources and availability. Preserve the catalog review dates and limits when citing it.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one published Chinese, English, Thai or Japanese article as Markdown. Use a known article slug from the site. An unknown slug returns an error.

tools.name: get_wong_tai_sin_stick
tools.description: Look up an existing Wong Tai Sin stick number from 1 to 100. Returns the published reference and reading in Chinese or English. Does not draw a random stick or create a personalised reading.
